system.description:
You are skilled in the art of defense, protecting yourself and your nearby allies. Weapons that qualify for this stance are known as Stalwart Weapons. You gain the following benefits.

When you take the Dodge action on your turn, you also gain advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

When an allied creature within 5 feet of you would take damage from an attack, you can spend your reaction to interpose yourself. The attack now targets you instead. The allied creature cannot be targeted by the same creature until the end of the current turn.

When you interpose yourself and the attack misses you, you can make one opportunity attack against the attacking creature if they are within your reach.

Beginning at 5th level, when you make a weapon attack or a melee Taijutsu attack using a Stalwart Weapon, you can replace one attack with a Guardian Strike.

Guardian Strike. Make a weapon attack against a hostile creature within your reach. On a hit, deal your Weapon Damage. Until the start of your next turn, the first time that creature would deal damage to an allied creature within 5 feet of you, reduce that damage by your Weapon Damage die result.

Beginning at 10th level, when you interpose using this stance to intercept damage, double your weapons Blocking property value, ignoring normal limits. The triggering attack does not automatically hit as normal, and instead if they miss, if you make an opportunity attack against the triggering creature, you can add your Blocking property value to the damage dealt.
